flows:
Navigate to https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Open the homepage search textbox using the header search icon and keyboard only.
Press Tab twice as the first two actions.
Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move across the header.
Press Enter on the search icon and check that the search textbox opens.
Opening the textbox is the required outcome.
